`final class ResourceProperties`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ResourceProperties.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/ResourceProperties.java)

The drawing settings of a resource handle, its filtering, its mipmaps and its region.

- [Images and media](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/)

|---|---|---|
| [`ResourceProperties`](/reference/resources/resourceproperties/) | [create](#ResourceProperties-factory-create)() <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span> | Creates settings with linear filtering, automatic mipmaps and no region. |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| [interpolation](#ResourceProperties-property-interpolation) | [`TextureFilter`](/reference/bridges/texturefilter/) | `TextureFilter.LINEAR` | The [`TextureFilter`](/reference/bridges/texturefilter/) used when the texture is scaled: `LINEAR` smooths, `NEAREST` keeps the pixels sharp. |
| [mipmap](#ResourceProperties-property-mipmap) | `boolean` | not forced | `true` to always use mipmaps, `false` to never use them; `null` lets JOID turn them on when the image is drawn smaller than its texture with linear filtering. |

## Creation details

<a id="ResourceProperties-factory-create"></a>

### create

`ResourceProperties create()` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates settings with linear filtering, automatic mipmaps and no region.

## Property details

<a id="ResourceProperties-property-interpolation"></a>

### interpolation

- `this interpolation(TextureFilter interpolation)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `TextureFilter getInterpolation()` 

**Default:** `TextureFilter.LINEAR`

The [`TextureFilter`](/reference/bridges/texturefilter/) used when the texture is scaled: `LINEAR` smooths, `NEAREST` keeps the pixels sharp.

<a id="ResourceProperties-property-mipmap"></a>

### mipmap

- `this mipmap(boolean mipmap)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Boolean getMipmap()` 

**Default:** not forced

`true` to always use mipmaps, `false` to never use them; `null` lets JOID turn them on when the image is drawn smaller than its texture with linear filtering.
